ME-01@1.0.0.title: Full news article
ME-01@1.0.0.routing_rule: Use original article text with publisher, byline, and dates. API and RSS links are discovery.

ME-02@1.0.0.title: Press release or public announcement
ME-02@1.0.0.routing_rule: Use the complete publisher release, in HTML or PDF, with attachments where substantive.

ME-03@1.0.0.title: Scholarly full-text XML
ME-03@1.0.0.routing_rule: Read the complete article, including sections, tables, and reference boundaries.

ME-04@1.0.0.title: Scholarly discovery to full text
ME-04@1.0.0.routing_rule: Resolve the citation or catalogue entry to the original article, thesis, or preprint. Do not analyze abstracts as full text.

ME-05@1.0.0.title: Original SEC submission
ME-05@1.0.0.routing_rule: Parse the complete submission and relevant exhibits. The issuer or EDGAR index is not the filing.

ME-06@1.0.0.title: XBRL statements and facts
ME-06@1.0.0.routing_rule: Extract concepts, units, fiscal periods, contexts, and filing references. Preserve original attachments.

ME-07@1.0.0.title: Issuer or ownership disclosure package
ME-07@1.0.0.routing_rule: Use the full filed documents or the original regulator bulk release. Keep index rows and filed records distinct.

ME-08@1.0.0.title: Official PDF document or report
ME-08@1.0.0.routing_rule: Read the publisher PDF, retaining page, table, and cell references. Use OCR when necessary.

ME-09@1.0.0.title: Official HTML document
ME-09@1.0.0.routing_rule: Read the complete publisher document. Retain section and table anchors and resolve substantive attachments.

ME-10@1.0.0.title: Clinical, regulatory, or legal record
ME-10@1.0.0.routing_rule: Parse the native record or case document and preserve regulatory identifiers, statuses, roles, and attachments. Follow discovery links where needed.

ME-11@1.0.0.title: Procurement and awards
ME-11@1.0.0.routing_rule: Parse native notice, lot, award, and place-of-performance fields, retaining source extensions and archive members.

ME-12@1.0.0.title: Time series and statistical API
ME-12@1.0.0.routing_rule: Preserve series keys, observation times, units, revisions, and release vintage where supplied.

ME-13@1.0.0.title: SDMX datasets
ME-13@1.0.0.routing_rule: Read series keys, dimensions, attributes, units, and observation vintages from the native SDMX response.

ME-14@1.0.0.title: Native API or structured records
ME-14@1.0.0.routing_rule: Use native JSON, XML, or record envelopes, preserving identifiers and original field paths.

ME-15@1.0.0.title: Delimited dataset
ME-15@1.0.0.routing_rule: Parse native CSV, TSV, or delimited text without losing original fields, units, notes, or reporting dates.

ME-16@1.0.0.title: Workbook or native tabular report
ME-16@1.0.0.routing_rule: Preserve workbook, sheet, row, and column provenance and capture units, headings, and reported methodology.

ME-17@1.0.0.title: Bulk release package
ME-17@1.0.0.routing_rule: Preserve the original archive and manifest. Validate and route member files using their native formats.

ME-18@1.0.0.title: Geospatial feature or grid
ME-18@1.0.0.routing_rule: Retain native geometries, coordinate systems, tiles, timestamps, measurements, and geographic roles.

ME-19@1.0.0.title: Catalogue or repository index
ME-19@1.0.0.routing_rule: Catalogued item metadata is valid for inventory and relationships. Retrieve originals before extracting document-level claims.

ME-20@1.0.0.title: Market, trade, shipping or holdings data
ME-20@1.0.0.routing_rule: Read native API rows, official tables, or release files for prices, positions, volumes, and commercial flows. Preserve instruments, venues, units, periods, and revisions.

ME-21@1.0.0.title: Patent publication or prosecution record
ME-21@1.0.0.routing_rule: Preserve application and publication IDs, actors, assignments, claims, and procedural events. Read linked originals for document-level extraction.

ME-22@1.0.0.title: Social post, comment, or discussion
ME-22@1.0.0.routing_rule: Preserve complete public posts or comments, authors, thread context, and post timestamps.

ME-23@1.0.0.title: Advertising and creative evidence
ME-23@1.0.0.routing_rule: Read native campaign and delivery fields. Link original creative for content analysis and flag missing assets.

ME-24@1.0.0.title: Survey and specialty data format
ME-24@1.0.0.routing_rule: Use native statistical readers for RDS, SAS transport, or survey releases. Keep codebooks, weights, and sample definitions.

ME-25@1.0.0.title: Entity registry and organization directory
ME-25@1.0.0.routing_rule: Read native record IDs, identifiers, names, roles, and reported activities. Use document parsing when the same provider publishes reports.

ME-26@1.0.0.title: Web or network capture
ME-26@1.0.0.routing_rule: Preserve capture timestamps and native WARC, crawl, or MRT record boundaries. Distinguish archive metadata from replayed content.

ME-27@1.0.0.title: Mixed data and publication release
ME-27@1.0.0.routing_rule: Identify the native artifact first, then use the matching data or document profile. Hold unsupported formats for inspection.
